_comment: OTP deep-analysis check configuration. Thresholds and MFA lists live here, never in .ex source, so they can be tuned without a recompile. Defaults must produce sane output on any Elixir codebase with zero tuning — a default that is wrong somewhere is release-gating, not 'the user can override'.

blocking_init._comment: Calls that block inside init/1. init/1 runs inside the supervisor's start sequence, so a blocking call serialises boot and a down dependency turns into a restart-intensity cascade. Patterns ending in '.*' match any function on that module; bare 'Mod.fun' matches exactly.
blocking_init._repo_convention_note: When true, any call to a module whose last segment is 'Repo' (Ecto's universal naming convention) counts as an error-tier DB call. Listing every project's repo module is impossible; the convention is the portable signal.

missing_catch_all_handle_info._comment: No tunables. `use GenServer` injects a default handle_info/2 that logs unexpected messages, but defining ANY clause overrides the injected default entirely — from then on a late Task reply, a :DOWN message or port noise crashes the server. The check fires only when clauses exist and none is an unguarded catch-all.
